verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official MCP server. It shows natural-language task queries such as "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" and read tools that return workspace data, plus a third-party Gemini Enterprise integration for searching across work apps. Nothing documents a native full-text search spanning tasks, docs and comments, and no evidence speaks to search speed or accuracy. Missing for 10: documented native search across tasks/docs/comments, comment search coverage, speed/relevance evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
